name: camphor oil + menthol + methyl salicylate
uses: USES Temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with arthritis, backache, strain, sprains, and bruises.
otcwarn: WARNINGS Avoid contact with eyes. If condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a doctor. Do not use in large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas.
